title: Redact binary FBX strings by their declared length
environment: Applies to path redaction in binary FBX files with the described string-property encoding. Do not generalize this replacement code to other FBX versions, binary formats, or arbitrary properties without format-specific validation.
goal: Remove absolute workspace paths from a binary FBX copy while preserving its structure and geometry for a downstream verification.
approach: Historical failed assumption: The path was treated as a null-terminated byte string. Binary FBX stores string properties with an `S` type marker and a length prefix, and arbitrary binary fields can follow the string before a null byte.
what_worked: Historical correction: For each candidate path, require the preceding `S` marker, read the little-endian 32-bit payload length, validate the full payload and expected suffix, and replace only that payload with an equal-length neutral value. Fail closed if any check is unexpected. Verification reported by the source: The redacted copy retained the original byte length; byte comparison showed that only the matched string payload ranges changed. Blender imported the copy, and a geometry/winding comparison completed on that copy.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: A byte-regex replacement that ran from a drive-letter path through the next null byte produced an FBX that Blender could not parse and reported a nested-block sentinel error.
why: The regex replaced bytes beyond the string payload, corrupting later binary structure. This was reproduced by the failed import; preserving the declared string length fixed that failure.
improved_method: Do not redact binary FBX paths with null-terminated regex spans. Parse and validate the string-property marker and declared length, replace only the payload with equal-length bytes, then verify both structural import and the downstream semantic check.
when_to_use: Applies to path redaction in binary FBX files with the described string-property encoding. Do not generalize this replacement code to other FBX versions, binary formats, or arbitrary properties without format-specific validation.
when_not_to_use: Do not generalize this replacement code to other FBX versions, binary formats, or arbitrary properties without format-specific validation.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
